message.content:
This vertical cover of "TEMPO" magazine features a central illustration of a hot air balloon against a blue sky with soft white clouds. The balloon's envelope is a warm orange and yellow, with a bright white flame glowing at the center. Below the envelope, a brown woven wicker basket is attached by ropes. Two men are on the basket. On the left, a man in a light grey long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers hangs off the outside, smiling broadly with his hands raised. On the right, a man in a blue long-sleeved shirt leans out of the basket, holding a red cloth aloft and looking towards the lower right. In the bottom right foreground, a man is seen from the back, wearing a light grey vest with "KPK" printed in black and red on the shoulder.

White text at the top reads "KABAR KABUR JAMAAH ISLAMIYAH BARU" and "SILANG SENGKARUT PELEBURAN DANA PENSIUN." The large word "TEMPO" is centered in white. Below it, small white letters spell "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline in bold black letters is "GEMBIRA BERSAMA TEMENGGUNG." Smaller orange and white text describes the release of Syafruddin Arsyad Temenggung and its impact on a KPK investigation into Sjamsul Nursalim. A barcode and publishing details for July 15-21, 2019, are at the bottom left.
